key_insight: A general-purpose language-model agent combines materials data, predictive models and reaction pathways to turn plain-language questions into testable synthesis plans.
engineering_relevance: The workflow could accelerate materials screening and experimental planning by linking predicted properties and stability to precursors, crucibles and synthesis atmospheres.
method: Connect the agent to Alexandria’s crystal database, generative model and property predictors.
Use a reaction graph to assess candidate synthesis energetics.
Screen solar absorbers and propose sulfide candidates with experimental validation plans.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports about 15 million DFT calculations and a graph of 17.4 billion reactions, with unattended case studies producing candidates beyond those proposed using web search alone.
watch_item: The proposed materials and synthesis plans still require laboratory validation; the abstract reports no experimental confirmation.
paper_title: Materials research with a general-purpose agent
